name: personal-claude-plugin-marketplace
description: Personal, reusable Claude Code plugins: project bootstrapping, review, testing, and framework work.

plugins.name: universal-clean-code
plugins.description: The house standard for readable, maintainable code: naming, function shape, error handling, comments, and dependency direction.

plugins.name: universal-work-discipline
plugins.description: How to work in a place someone else maintains: read first, match what is there, hold scope, and never call unverified work done.

plugins.name: craft-development
plugins.description: What careful work means for code: test first, the neighbours to read, a diff kept to the change, and verification with typecheck, tests and lint.

plugins.name: craft-review
plugins.description: How to review any piece of work: know what it is meant to do, read it as written, trace one case, and report only findings with a cost.

plugins.name: craft-code-review
plugins.description: Structured review of a diff or branch: correctness, security, tests, and API surface.

plugins.name: craft-unit-testing
plugins.description: Writes and strengthens unit tests: test first in a red, green, refactor cycle, behavior-first cases, edge coverage, no assertion padding.

plugins.name: craft-refactoring
plugins.description: Behavior-preserving refactors executed in small, verifiable steps with a green test suite as the gate.

plugins.name: craft-cv-writing
plugins.description: Writing and tailoring a CV: terms in context, both forms of an alias, exact verbs, one defensible figure per project, and no invented facts.

plugins.name: language-java
plugins.description: Java language conventions: version-aware idioms, nullability, immutability, exceptions, and resource handling.

plugins.name: language-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript language conventions: strictness, narrowing over assertions, discriminated unions, and async discipline.

plugins.name: language-javascript
plugins.description: JavaScript language conventions: ES modules with explicit extensions, named exports, async/await at every layer, and a logger in library code.

plugins.name: language-swift
plugins.description: Swift language conventions: the language mode, optionals handled not forced, value types, thrown errors, narrow access control, and concurrency stated in types.

plugins.name: language-simple-english
plugins.description: English nobody can read two ways, after Simplified Technical English: short sentences, one instruction each, one word per meaning, active voice, no filler.

plugins.name: tools-vue
plugins.description: Vue 3 Composition API conventions for components, reactivity, composables, and templates.

plugins.name: tools-vue-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript in Vue 3: props and emits typed through the generic form, and typed reactive inputs for composables.

plugins.name: tools-pinia
plugins.description: Pinia store conventions: setup-syntax stores, and server data in a query layer rather than a store.

plugins.name: tools-aws-static-hosting
plugins.description: Static hosting on AWS: S3 behind CloudFront, certificate region, deep links, cache tiers, private buckets, safe syncs, and checks after a deploy.

plugins.name: marketplace-steward
plugins.description: Sets a project up for agentic work and keeps the setup current: writes its CLAUDE.md, installs the skills it needs, and generates a Plan/Do/Check trio per recurring task. Adopts a setup a project already has, giving every rule one home, and turns a lesson into a skill change by pull request.
